post.description:
Apply a batch of widget mutations in one Postgres transaction.

Requires ``Idempotency-Key`` (or ``X-Idempotency-Key``). Redis caches the success
payload for safe retry after network drop mid-response. Failures raise so the
session dependency rolls back the entire batch (outbox must stay intact client-side).

DiscussionEventsStreamSsePayloadDoc.title: DiscussionEventsStreamSsePayloadDoc
DiscussionEventsStreamSsePayloadDoc.description:
OpenAPI doc for Discussion ``GET …/events`` ``text/event-stream`` ``data:`` JSON.

Named SSE ``event:`` values include ``discussion_session``, ``discussion_turn_plan``,
``council_turn``, ``discussion_pause``, ``discussion_segment_done``,
``discussion_document_ready``, and ``error``. Keep-alive comments are outside this union.
FE refreshes PG SoT by event name; payload shapes may carry session and/or turn fields.

DesktopAiChatStreamSsePayloadDoc.title: DesktopAiChatStreamSsePayloadDoc
DesktopAiChatStreamSsePayloadDoc.description:
OpenAPI doc for Desktop AI Chat ``POST …/chats/{id}/stream`` ``data:`` JSON.

Wire frames are ``data: {JSON}\n\n`` with ``event`` inside the JSON (not SSE
``event:`` lines). Named values include ``token``, ``done``, ``error``,
``speaker_start``, ``council_turn``, ``ensemble_plan``, ``tools``,
``assistant_document_replace``, plus planning/action/polish frames via
``DesktopAiChatStreamSseNamedOut``. Keep-alive comments are outside this union.
